name: Magacela (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and green below, charged towards the upper fly with the crowned municipal arms of Magacela (ears of wheat on green and a tower on black).
history: Municipal flag of Magacela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Magacela arms — ears of wheat and tower
